name: When should a chiropractor consider implementing AEO?
description: A chiropractor should implement AEO early to gain a competitive edge in the evolving search landscape, especially with increasing voice assistant and AI search

mainEntity.name: When should a chiropractor consider implementing AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A chiropractor should consider implementing AEO as soon as possible, especially if they are looking to gain a competitive edge and adapt to the evolving search landscape. With the increasing use of voice assistants and AI-powered search, early adoption of AEO can position your practice as a leader in your local market. It's particularly beneficial if your current digital marketing efforts are plateauing or if you want to capture patients who prefer quick, direct answers without browsing multiple websites. Implementing AEO proactively prepares your practice for future search trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: A chiropractor should implement AEO early to gain a competitive edge in the evolving search landscape, especially with increasing voice assistant and AI search usage.
